test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I saw a man _______ was wearing a black coat.
solution:
The correct answer is '**who**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**who**" is a relative pronoun used to refer to a person or people.
 
• In this sentence, we are referring to a man, and "**who**" is the appropriate relative pronoun to describe him.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **4** are grammatically incorrect in the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"I saw a man **who**__ was wearing a black coat."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "which"** is incorrect because it refers to objects, not people.
 
• **Option 2: "whom"** is incorrect because it is used in the objective case, not the subject case.
 
• **Option 4: "whose"** is incorrect because it indicates possession, which is irrelevant here.
